response_durations.definition: intervals inside the registered response windows whose deviation from the pre-onset baseline is > 0, longest of the two response resources

peak_ratio.definition: max over the registered response resources of response_Q / pre-onset baseline_Q

A.note: onsets an unmapped scan attributes to this regime that its own task cohort does not produce; the instrument's tests pin that a regime-A envelope crosses the B/C thresholds, so the unmapped number is reported and never used as a gate input

B.note: onsets an unmapped scan attributes to this regime that its own task cohort does not produce; the instrument's tests pin that a regime-A envelope crosses the B/C thresholds, so the unmapped number is reported and never used as a gate input

C.note: onsets an unmapped scan attributes to this regime that its own task cohort does not produce; the instrument's tests pin that a regime-A envelope crosses the B/C thresholds, so the unmapped number is reported and never used as a gate input

A.measurement_source: per-task maximum of the onset resource column over the familiar-phase rows of this stream

B.measurement_source: per-task maximum of the onset resource column over the familiar-phase rows of this stream

C.measurement_source: per-task maximum of the onset resource column over the familiar-phase rows of this stream

task_regime_map_summary.id_space: canonical core23 regime ids (A/B/C) for tasks created under a registered regime, 'familiar' for a task with no envelope

definitions.familiar_phase: set_active_regime(None, probability=0.00): the registered mechanism is off, i.e. the frozen familiar generator exactly (T-AUDIT-05 identity)
definitions.phase_and_regime_columns_are_audit_only: phase_ids / phase_kind / phase_cascade_probability / phase_regime_ids / cascade_* / host_cascade_* are audit metadata and must never be a model input (FORBIDDEN_INPUTS)
definitions.task_envelope_frozen_at_creation: a task created inside a phase keeps the envelope of the phase it was created under; the collector never re-adapts an existing container at a switch
definitions.onset_scan_cohort: each regime is scanned with task_regime_map restricted to its own tasks; the unmapped scan is reported next to it as the cross-hit confound count
